idea-plugin.name: pony-malta-pugin
idea-plugin.description:
Pony Malta is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin for exploring Java business logic through an interactive call graph.

Analyze method execution flow, navigate between caller and callee methods, and visualize application architecture by layers such as Controller, Service, Repository, DTO, Entity, and Utility.

  • 🌳 Interactive Flow View
  • 📂 Layer-based Architecture View
  • 🔍 Search within the call tree
  • 🖱 Double-click to navigate directly to source code
  • 🎨 Colored nodes and contextual method icons

action.description: Analyze method call flow with Pony Malta
